name: STE80 Humanizer
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and other agents through the skills CLI; Claude.ai and Claude Desktop by upload
short: An AI skill that strips the AI tells out of text, then rewrites it toward ASD-STE100, the plain English of aircraft manuals.
what: The skill works in two passes. Pass 1 removes 26 AI tells from Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing list. Pass 2 rebuilds sentences "80% of the way to ASD-STE100", following a tip from Andrej Karpathy: short sentences, one idea each, active voice. It has light and strict modes, reports each edit by rule number, and ships a small Python checker.
who: People who edit AI drafts, docs, READMEs or runbooks and want them easier to read. The README says getting past AI detectors is not a goal, so skip it if that is what you want.
needs: Node.js to run `npx` for the skills CLI, or Claude Code for the plugin route
Python if you want the `ste_check.py` checker

steps.title: Install with the skills CLI
steps.text: This puts the skill in the current project.

steps.title: Or install it for one agent everywhere
steps.text: Add `--global` and name your agent. `'*'` installs it for all of them.
steps.code:
npx skills add Dodaios/ste80-humanizer --global --agent claude-code
npx skills add Dodaios/ste80-humanizer --global --agent codex
npx skills add Dodaios/ste80-humanizer --global --agent cursor
npx skills add Dodaios/ste80-humanizer --global --agent '*'

steps.title: Or add it as a Claude Code plugin
Or upload it to Claude.ai or Claude Desktop
steps.text: Download the repo as a ZIP (Code, then Download ZIP) and upload it in Settings, Capabilities, Skills.

steps.title: Run it
steps.text: Call `/ste80-humanizer` and paste your text. It also starts by itself when you ask to humanize, simplify or de-AI a text.

steps.title: Check a file without AI
steps.text: The checker is a heuristic with no dependencies.

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Rewrite this README 80% of the way to ASD-STE100."

watch: STE is meant for explanatory text. For fiction, speeches and brand copy the skill only does Pass 1.
For languages other than English it applies the tells and structure rules but not the English word lists.
"STE style" is not "STE compliant". The skill does not contain the official ASD-STE100 specification or dictionary.
The checker is a heuristic. The README says it is not an AI detector and not a compliance checker.
